verdict.rationale: A public tax and e-invoicing service could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for integrators, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. The 'Simuler une taxe ou un crédit d'impôt' item is a tax-calculation simulator, an adjacent feature rather than an isolated testing environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
